mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.nickname, o.stall_id, s.name AS stall_name, o.total_amount, o.discount_amount, o.pay_amount, o.pickup_code, o.status, o.delivery_type, o.rider_id, r.name AS rider_name, o.delivery_status, o.create_time FROM order_info o JOIN stall s ON s.id = o.stall_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN rider r ON r.id = o.rider_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_info (order_no, user_id, stall_id, total_amount, discount_amount, pay_amount, pickup_code, status, delivery_type, rider_id, delivery_status) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{stallId}, #{totalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{pickupCode}, #{status}, #{deliveryType}, #{riderId}, #{deliveryStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, stall_id, total_amount, discount_amount, pay_amount, pickup_code, status, delivery_type, rider_id, delivery_status, create_time, update_time FROM order_info WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT pickup_code FROM order_info WHERE stall_id = #{stallId} AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND delivery_type = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE order_info SET rider_id = #{riderId}, delivery_status = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND delivery_status = 0 AND status = 0
UPDATE order_info SET delivery_status = 2, status = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND delivery_status = 1 AND status = 0
